name: Appsmith
tagline: Low-code platform to build internal tools
description: Appsmith is a low-code platform for building internal dashboards, admin panels, and CRUD tools fast. It connects to databases and APIs, offers a drag-and-drop canvas, and lets you write JavaScript where the presets end. A practical shortcut for teams that need tools, not a framework.
highlights: Drag-and-drop UI builder with a JS editor
Connect any REST API, GraphQL, or database
Reusable widgets and pages with permissions
curatorNote: Appsmith is what internal tools look like when you refuse to build the same CRUD app for the fourth time. The JS escape hatch keeps it honest.
